_readme: FreshStart Membership plans (source: 'FreshStart Subscription Model – Proposal', Nov 2026). Prices are per month, transport and supplies included in the six North QC areas. Edit prices here; /membership/ and the home page read this file.

faqs.q: How do I pay for a membership?
faqs.a: By GCash or bank transfer. Pay monthly by the 25th, or in two halves on the 15th and 30th (each half paid before the visits it covers). Your first payment is made before the first visit. Every payment gets a BIR-registered invoice; our cleaners never collect cash.

faqs.q: Can I pay ahead for a discount?
faqs.a: Yes. Pay 6 months ahead and save 5%, or 12 months ahead and save 10%. Yearly payers keep their price for the whole term.

faqs.q: Is there a discount if my neighbours join?
faqs.a: Yes, the Kapitbahay rate: 8% off Home Tidy and 5% off Home Fresh when 2 or more homes on the same street or subdivision share a cleaning day. It replaces the pay-ahead discount.

faqs.q: Can I skip or move a visit?
faqs.a: Yes, free with 24 hours' notice. Later than that, or if we can't get in on arrival, there is a ₱300 fee and the visit counts as used.

faqs.q: What happens to a missed visit?
faqs.a: Fresh members can roll over 1 visit and Spotless members 2 visits, to be used by the end of the next month. Tidy visits don't roll over.
Yes, for travel or holidays: up to 2 weeks a year on Tidy, 4 weeks on Fresh and 6 weeks on Spotless. Paused weeks are credited to your next bill.

faqs.q: How do I cancel, and do I get a refund?
faqs.a: Home Tidy and Fresh run month to month: tell us 7 days before your next billing date. Home Spotless, Business and Custom have a 3-month minimum, Industrial 6 months; after that, Business and Industrial give 30 days' notice. Unused prepaid months are refunded: what you paid minus the months used at the full monthly price. Delivered visits aren't refunded; the free re-clean covers quality.

faqs.q: Can I get a weekend visit?
faqs.a: Our regular hours are Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 9 PM. Weekend visits are by appointment at +30%. Home Spotless includes 1 weekend visit a month at no surcharge, and Business Spotless includes a Saturday visit swap.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade or switch plans?
faqs.a: Upgrade any time, from your next visit; the difference for the rest of the month is billed pro rata. Downgrades and plan switches start on your next billing date.

faqs.q: What does the price lock mean?
faqs.a: Members who pay 12 months ahead keep their monthly price for the whole 12 months. Other monthly members get 60 days' notice of any price change.

Heavy build-up (we do a one-time deep clean first), post-renovation dust and work above 2 metres in homes; medical waste, sterile areas, grease traps and hood ducts in businesses; hazardous waste, chemical spills, confined spaces and inside production machinery on industrial sites.
